key_insight: Sign-hedged beam RQAOA reduces irreversible elimination errors by exploring both sign assignments, recovering near-optimal solutions on frustrated SK instances without increasing QAOA depth p.
engineering_relevance: Beam search adds a decision-side improvement to fixed-p quantum optimization, trading extra circuit evaluations and classical processing for better solution quality.
method: Keep standard RQAOA’s selected variable or pair, but branch on both possible sign assignments.
Rank residual problems with a classical score and retain the best B candidates.
Complete survivors with ordinary RQAOA and exactly solve a small remaining core.
evidence_signal: Across 50+ HamLib and QOBLIB instances up to 60 qubits, with runs on ibm kingston and ibm marrakesh, the authors report consistent simulator–hardware beam rankings and SK approximation-ratio recovery from 0.474 to 0.998 at the same p.
watch_item: The gains require additional residual-circuit evaluations, classical pruning, and small-core exact solving; they do not establish quantum advantage or circuit-only scalability.
paper_title: Sign-hedged Beam QAOA:Scaling Quantum Optimization Algorithms
